seo_title: Cost of Living in Siem Reap 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Siem Reap per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A town next to the temples of Angkor: a simple visa on arrival, very cheap living and a relaxed pace. US dollars are in everyday use; the downsides are the heat, basic healthcare and the rainy season.
pros: A relaxed pace and an expat community

visa_steps.title: Visa on arrival / e-visa
visa_steps.description: Russians can get a tourist visa on arrival or online for 30 days.

visa_steps.title: Renting a home
visa_steps.description: Houses and apartments are rented monthly very cheaply.

visa_steps.title: Money
visa_steps.description: US dollars are in everyday use; riel is given as change. You need a foreign bank card.

visa_steps.title: Business visa (type E)
visa_steps.description: For a long-term stay, get a type E visa with a one-year extension.

visa_steps.title: Transport
visa_steps.description: Tuk-tuks and bicycles are handy around town; tuk-tuk to Angkor.

faq.question: Do Russians need a visa for Siem Reap?
faq.answer: Yes, a simple visa on arrival or e-visa for 30 days. For long-term living, you get a type E business visa.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Siem Reap?
faq.answer: Very cheap — one of the most budget-friendly options in Asia. See the exact budget in the calculator above.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Siem Reap?
faq.answer: Khmer; English is widely used in tourism.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Siem Reap?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. US dollars in cash and a foreign bank card are in use.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Siem Reap?
faq.answer: Tropical: hot year-round, with distinct dry and rainy seasons.

faq.question: How does Siem Reap differ from Phnom Penh?
faq.answer: Siem Reap is a quiet temple town by Angkor; Phnom Penh is the capital and business centre.

reviews.text: Siem Reap means Angkor right next door and rock-bottom prices, with dollars everywhere. The downsides are the heat, basic healthcare and the town's heavy reliance on tourism.
A quiet little town with great temples nearby. Living is very cheap and the community is friendly. It's humid in the rains, and for serious medical care people go to Bangkok.
